title: Generative AI using Python
overview: This course provides an in-depth exploration of Generative AI techniques using Python, empowering participants to design and implement AI models that can generate data, create content, and solve complex problems. Generative AI focuses on deep learning models that can generate text, images, audio, and other types of data. The course covers practical aspects of building and training models such as Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), and transformer models using Python libraries like TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Hugging Face.

The course will teach participants how to leverage Generative AI to create innovative solutions and applications in fields like content generation, product design, music creation, and data augmentation.
audience: Data scientists and machine learning engineers looking to specialize in generative models
Software developers with an interest in deep learning and AI
AI enthusiasts and professionals who wish to explore creative applications of AI
Researchers working on cutting-edge AI models
Tech entrepreneurs interested in generative AI-based products or services
Familiarity with machine learning concepts (e.g., supervised vs unsupervised learning)
Familiarity with basic deep learning principles (e.g., neural networks, backpropagation)
Basic knowledge of libraries like NumPy, Pandas, TensorFlow, or Py-Torch is helpful but not required.
methodology: The course employs a hands-on learning approach, with the following elements:
Instructor-led lectures covering theoretical concepts of generative models
Practical coding exercises to build and train generative models using Python
Real-world case studies of Generative AI applications in various industries
Interactive Q&A sessions and peer discussions to foster collaborative learning
Capstone project where participants create a generative model to solve a real-world problem
Support materials including notebooks, code samples, and datasets
competencies: By the end of this course, participants will be able to:
Understand the key concepts of Generative AI, including GANs, VAEs, and transformer models
Implement and train Generative AI models using Python and popular deep learning frameworks
Generate realistic data such as images, text, and music using AI models
Analyze and evaluate the performance of generative models
Create applications and solutions leveraging generative AI in real-world scenarios
Understand the ethical implications and limitations of generative models
objectivesIntro: Upon completion of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Build and train generative models using Python and deep learning frameworks like Py-Torch and TensorFlow.
Apply Generative AI techniques to generate text, images, and other content
Develop GANs (Generative Adversarial Networks) for applications like image generation, data augmentation, and style transfer
Implement VAEs (Variational Autoencoders) for tasks such as latent space exploration and anomaly detection.
Leverage transformer-based models (e.g., GPT, BERT) for text generation and NLP tasks
Evaluate generative models in terms of performance and generated content quality
Deploy generative models in production environments for scalable applications

outline.title: Module 1: Introduction to Generative AI and Python Basics

items.text: Overview of Generative AI and its applications (text, image, audio generation)
Key concepts in deep learning for generative models
Introduction to Python for AI development
Setting up the development environment: Jupyter Notebooks, Python libraries (NumPy, Pandas, TensorFlow, Py-Torch)
Overview of machine learning frameworks: TensorFlow vs Py-Torch
What are Generative Models? Key differences from discriminative models
Overview of probabilistic models and latent variables
Introduction to Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs)
Introduction to Variational Autoencoders (VAEs)
Hands-on: Basic image generation with GANs and VAEs
Understanding the architecture of GANs: Generator vs Discriminator
Training GANs and overcoming challenges like mode collapse and instability
Applications of GANs in image generation, style transfer, and data augmentation
Hands-on: Building and training a GAN for image generation using Py-Torch.
Techniques for improving GAN performance (e.g., DCGAN, WGAN, LSGAN)

outline.title: Module 4: Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) and Latent Space Exploration

items.text: Introduction to Autoencoders: Structure and functioning
Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) and the concept of probabilistic inference
Latent space representation: Exploration and manipulation
Applications of VAEs in image generation, anomaly detection, and data compression
Hands-on: Building a VAE for latent space exploration using TensorFlow

outline.title: Module 5: Transformer Models for Text Generation

items.text: Understanding the transformer architecture: Attention mechanism, encoder-decoderOverview of popular models: GPT, BERT, T5
Text generation with GPT-based models
Fine-tuning pre-trained models for text generation, summarization, and question answering
Hands-on: Building a text generation model using GPT-2 or GPT-3 and Hugging Face's Transformers library

outline.title: Module 6: Applications of Generative AI in Real-World Scenarios

items.text: Use cases of Generative AI in various industries: Art, music, fashion, healthcare, finance
AI for content generation: writing, art, and design
AI in healthcare: Drug discovery, medical image generation, and diagnosis
Ethical concerns in Generative AI: Bias, misinformation, and copyright issues
Hands-on: Developing a practical application using a generative model

outline.title: Module 7: Evaluating and Tuning Generative Models

items.text: Metrics for evaluating the quality of generated content
Common evaluation methods: FID, IS, BLEU scores for images and text
Hyperparameter tuning for better model performance
Techniques for improving generative model quality
Hands-on: Evaluating GANs and VAEs for performance and content quality

outline.title: Module 8: Deploying and Scaling Generative AI Models

items.text: Deploying generative models in production environments
Optimizing and scaling generative models using cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure)
Serving models with Flask/Fast-API and integrating them into applications
Best practices for model maintenance and updates
Hands-on: Deploying a trained GAN or VAE model to a cloud platform

outline.title: Module 9: Capstone Project – Building a Generative AI Application

items.text: Participants work on a real-world project applying generative models
Develop a fully functional generative AI application (e.g., image generator, text generator, etc.)
Peer review and expert feedback
Final course recap, Q&A, and certification discussion
